title: Coasts 6: Case Study - Florida, USA
subject: Geography
description: Case study of coastal erosion and tropical storms in Florida: causes, impacts and management.
author: Erick

cards.front: Florida: which country is it a state of?
Florida: which ocean lies to the east?
Florida: which sea lies to the south?
Florida's coastline is the ___ longest of all US states.
Florida: how does the type of coastline cause erosion and flooding?
cards.back: It is made of soft sediment with sandy beaches and very few cliffs.

cards.front: Florida: how does the relief cause erosion and flooding?
Florida: how do tropical storms cause erosion and flooding?
cards.back: Florida is very vulnerable to tropical storms and gets hit majorly every year. It is one of the most hurricane-prone states.

cards.front: Florida: how has urbanisation increased erosion?
cards.back: Coastal development has altered natural processes such as longshore drift, reducing the ability of beaches to adapt to changing conditions.

cards.front: Florida: how much of its 1,328 km of sandy beach is critically eroded?

cards.back: The land has been lost to the sea and can't be recovered.

cards.front: Florida: what happened to coastal properties in Naples and Sarasota?
cards.back: Erosion damaged waterfront homes and hotels, and weakened natural defences against storm surges.

cards.front: Florida: what has happened in the Everglades and the Florida Keys?
cards.back: Mangroves and coastal habitats have become increasingly vulnerable to erosion, leading to habitat loss and removing a natural coastal defence.

cards.front: Florida: how are tropical storms managed?
cards.back: Evacuation zones, emergency shelters with food and supplies, and early warning systems.

cards.front: Where is the US National Hurricane Center?

questions.question: How much of Florida's sandy beach is critically eroded?
questions.explanation: 696 km out of 1,328 km of sandy beach is critically eroded: over half.

questions.question: Which sea lies to the south of Florida?
questions.explanation: The Gulf of Mexico is to the south and the Atlantic Ocean to the east.

questions.question: Which is a human cause of erosion in Florida?
questions.explanation: Coastal development has altered natural processes like longshore drift. The others are physical causes.

questions.question: Where in Florida did erosion damage waterfront homes and hotels?
questions.explanation: In Naples and Sarasota, erosion damaged waterfront homes and hotels.
